name: Data and reporting
summary: Find dashboards, reporting applications and data integration services

details.title: Enterprise data services
details.html: UIT Data Management and Analytics supports institutional reporting, data management and systems integration. Services include Insight, eReports, Power BI and data-management support

details.title: Insight
details.html: Insight provides admissions and enrolment reporting for authorized employees. Faculties manage access through designated approvers; an employee Passport York account is required

details.title: eReports
details.html: eReports provides operational reporting combining finance, employee and fundraising data. Reports are generally based on the prior business day and can be exported as PDF or Excel, subject to authorization
